moment: Bilbo's eleventy-first birthday party: a night-time garden party on a grassy field in front of a round green hill-home. Small barefoot curly-haired folk dance around a ribbon maypole, two long feast tables with candles and diners, one striped cake tent, a child carrying a lit birthday cake, lanterns in one big oak, fireworks in a plain dark sky, only a hedge and round doors behind.

The Mos Eisley cantina: one dim round-arched sandstone bar room with a big circular bar and a six-armed bartender, a four-piece alien band on a small stage, two curved red booths and a card table full of varied aliens, a waitress carrying a tray, a small round droid by a pillar, plain back wall.
guest: Paddington Bear, trying to order a marmalade sandwich

moment: The Great Hall at Hogwarts during the start-of-term feast: one stone hall with floating candles, four long tables of students in black robes and red, yellow, blue and green scarves, a raised teachers' table at the far end, golden plates and roast food, first-years lined up before a stool with a battered pointed hat, a grey ghost by a pillar.
guest: Shrek, sitting at the Hufflepuff table

moment: A Singapore hawker centre at lunch rush: one open-sided food hall with ceiling fans, a row of six food stalls with neon signs and steaming woks, queues at each, round tables of diners eating noodles and drinking iced drinks, a tray-carrying auntie, an uncle reading the newspaper, a cleaner with a tray trolley, palm trees outside.
guest: Kermit the Frog, choping a table with a tissue packet

moment: The Quidditch World Cup final, seconds before the Snitch is caught, stands packed with screaming fans
guest: Shrek, deeply unimpressed by the sport

moment: The spirit bathhouse from Spirited Away on a busy night
guest: Kermit the Frog, waiting for a bath

moment: The Battle of Helm's Deep, rain, torches and Uruk-hai at the walls
guest: SpongeBob SquarePants, lost on his way to work

moment: Singapore National Day Parade at the Padang, fighter jets overhead, crowds in red and white
